senses.en: a person who was born in the 1980s, 1990s, or early 2000s
examples: [[Millennials]] have grown up with the Internet and can't imagine a world without it.

senses.zh: 谈论， 追忆（快乐的往事）
senses.en: talk or think about pleasant events in your past
examples: We sat side by side, [[reminiscing]] about the past.

senses.en: feeling sad because you do not want to do what you are doing
examples: I must [[regretfully]] decline your invitation.

senses.zh: 评论，谈到，说起（尤指刚察觉的事）
senses.en: say sth., esp. about sth. you have just noticed
examples: Anderson left the table, [[remarking]] that he had some work to do.
He made a number of rude [[remarks]] about the food.

senses.en: sth. that you say when you express an opinion or say what you have noticed
examples: Anderson left the table, [[remarking]] that he had some work to do.
He made a number of rude [[remarks]] about the food.

senses.en: a fact or an event in nature or society, esp. one that is not fully understood
examples: Language is a social and cultural [[phenomenon]].
The rock band was a [[phenomenon]] — nobody had heard anything like them before.

senses.zh: 非凡的人（事物）；奇才；奇事
senses.en: sb. / sth. that is very unusual because of a rare quality or ability that they have
examples: Language is a social and cultural [[phenomenon]].
The rock band was a [[phenomenon]] — nobody had heard anything like them before.

senses.en: a very large number of things produced at the same time
examples: Technology is offering us an [[outpouring]] of opportunities that will help us stay curious and creative.
The news of his death produced an instant [[outpouring]] of grief.

senses.en: an uncontrolled expression of strong feelings
examples: Technology is offering us an [[outpouring]] of opportunities that will help us stay curious and creative.
The news of his death produced an instant [[outpouring]] of grief.

senses.zh: 自发的；自然而生的；一时冲动的
senses.en: happening or done in a natural, often sudden way, without any planning or without being forced
examples: The audience broke into [[spontaneous]] applause.

senses.en: a feeling of great surprise
examples: Much to the [[amazement]] of her family, she left school to pursue her acting career.

senses.en: a condition of life that causes difficulty or suffering
examples: People suffered many [[hardships]] during that long winter.

senses.zh: （经济、商业等活动的）下降，衰退
senses.en: a reduction in economic, business, or other activity
examples: There is evidence of a [[downturn]] in the housing market.

senses.en: (abbr. p.a.) (fml.) for each year
examples: The country exports goods worth $600 million [[per annum]].

senses.en: (only before noun) only
examples: The story was published with the [[sole]] purpose of selling newspapers.

senses.en: sb.'s ability to do sth.
examples: They are worried about their [[capacity]] to invest for the future.
The newly-built theater has a seating [[capacity]] of 2,000.

senses.en: the amount of space a container, room, etc. has to hold things or people
examples: They are worried about their [[capacity]] to invest for the future.
The newly-built theater has a seating [[capacity]] of 2,000.

senses.en: a child or young person
examples: These courses are specially designed for [[youngsters]] aged seven to nine.

senses.zh: 见多识广的；老练的；练达的
senses.en: having a lot of experience of life, and good judgment about socially important things such as art and fashion.
examples: Mark is a smart and [[sophisticated]] young man.

senses.en: the way in which a person or a group of people lives and works
examples: Many people are trying to adopt a healthy [[lifestyle]] these days.

senses.en: different from other people or things; doing things in your own way
examples: His music is highly [[individualistic]] and may not appeal to everyone.
A more [[individualistic]] society is also one with much more loneliness.

senses.en: believing that what individual people want is more important than what society or the government wants
examples: His music is highly [[individualistic]] and may not appeal to everyone.
A more [[individualistic]] society is also one with much more loneliness.

senses.en: having the qualities that are needed to succeed as an entrepreneur
examples: The successful candidate will be an [[entrepreneurial]], goal-oriented problem solver.

senses.en: sure that you have the ability to do things well or deal with situations successfully
examples: I feel much more [[confident]] about myself and my abilities these days.
We are [[confident]] that next year's profits will be higher.

senses.en: (not before noun) sure that sth. will happen in the way that you want or expect
examples: I feel much more [[confident]] about myself and my abilities these days.
We are [[confident]] that next year's profits will be higher.

senses.zh: 相当大的（尤指能产生影响或很重要）
senses.en: fairly large, esp. large enough to have an effect or be important
examples: [[Considerable]] progress has been made in finding a cure for the disease.

senses.en: frightening in a way that makes you feel less confident
examples: They were faced with the [[daunting]] task of restoring the house.

senses.zh: 理解，应付（困难复杂的情况）
senses.en: understand or deal with sth. difficult
examples: This outlook helped her [[navigate]] through her later years with success.
There weren't any road signs to help us [[navigate]] through the maze of one-way streets.

senses.en: find which way you need to go while traveling from one place to another
examples: This outlook helped her [[navigate]] through her later years with success.
There weren't any road signs to help us [[navigate]] through the maze of one-way streets.

senses.en: believe or say that sb. / sth. has a particular quality
examples: People were beginning to [[attribute]] superhuman qualities to him.
The fall in the number of deaths from heart disease is generally [[attributed]] to improvements in diet.

senses.en: believe or say that a situation or event is caused by sth.
examples: People were beginning to [[attribute]] superhuman qualities to him.
The fall in the number of deaths from heart disease is generally [[attributed]] to improvements in diet.

senses.en: (infml.) knowing a lot about sth. and able to make good judgments about it
examples: She bought the laptop on the advice of a computer-[[savvy]] friend.
He's obviously got a lot of political [[savvy]].

senses.en: (infml.) practical knowledge and ability
examples: She bought the laptop on the advice of a computer-[[savvy]] friend.
He's obviously got a lot of political [[savvy]].

senses.zh: （尤指在政治和教育方面） 进步的，先进的
senses.en: supporting new or modern ideas and methods, esp. in politics and education
examples: We're looking for [[progressive]] ideas to move the company forward.

senses.en: (fml.) think of sth. in a particular way or as having a particular quality
examples: These buildings are [[deemed]] to be of architectural importance and must be protected.

senses.en: (BrE self-centred) tending to think only about yourself and not thinking about the needs or feelings of other people
examples: She sounds totally [[self-centered]] and is showing you no consideration.

senses.zh: （由于自身身份）认为应得的，有权利的，有资格的
senses.en: feeling that you have the right to do or have what you want without having to work for it or deserve it, just because of who you are
examples: I don't want to make my kids feel [[entitled]] only because I am a teacher at this school.

senses.en: the act of buying and using products
examples: These products are not for national [[consumption]], but for export.
The government is determined to reduce the UK's total energy [[consumption]].

senses.en: the amount of energy, oil, electricity, etc. that is used
examples: These products are not for national [[consumption]], but for export.
The government is determined to reduce the UK's total energy [[consumption]].

senses.en: (forecast, forecast; forecasted, forecasted) say what you expect to happen in the future
examples: They [[forecast]] a large drop in unemployment over the next two years.
The weather [[forecast]] said it was going to rain.

senses.en: a statement of what is expected to happen in the future, esp. in relation to a particular event or situation
examples: They [[forecast]] a large drop in unemployment over the next two years.
The weather [[forecast]] said it was going to rain.

senses.en: a strong desire to have or achieve sth.
examples: When I was 12, I had [[aspirations]] to play professional basketball.

senses.zh: 此外；而且；不仅如此；更有甚者
senses.en: (fml.) in addition to what has already been said
examples: She always arrives on time; [[furthermore]], her work is always excellent.

senses.en: (electronic commerce) the business of buying and selling of goods and services on the Internet
examples: Travel companies have moved from the traditional bricks-and-mortar (实体的) environment to [[e-commerce]].

senses.zh: 时髦的；受新潮思想影响的
senses.en: influenced by the most fashionable styles and ideas
examples: He writes for some [[trendy]] magazine.

senses.en: a fashion, game, type of music, etc. that becomes very popular for a short time
examples: If history is any guide, this latest diet for losing weight is just another [[craze]].

senses.en: apart from
examples: Are you studying any science subjects other than chemistry?

senses.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first
examples: The company lost $13 million this year, in contrast to a profit of $15 million last year.

senses.en: used for talking about the ways in which two things are different, or about the ways in which sth. has changed
examples: Unemployment in the region currently stands at 10.1 percent, as compared to a national average of 7.7 percent.

senses.zh: 与···产生共鸣；与···产生情感联结
senses.en: (figuratively) resonate with; feel emotionally relevant to
examples: If this story [[spoke to]] you, I very much want to hear from you.

senses.zh: 墨尔本 (澳大利亚城市，位于维多利亚州)
